title: A linked Part Library entry keeps its tags and gains the new one
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin who can switch between two locations, the test location and location B, so a part can be stocked at location B only.
  • Create a part for this test at location B only, part A, with exactly two tags, tag 1 and tag 2, so part A is not stocked at the test location.
  • Use a third tag, tag 3, that part A does not have.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a description in the Description field.
  3. Type part A's part number in the Part Number field.
  4. Type tag 3 in the Tags field.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Pick any category in the Category field.
  7. Type 10.00 in the Cost field.
  8. Click Save.
  9. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  10. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads part A's part number.

Step 4:

  • The Tags field holds the text.

Step 5:

  • Tag 3 shows as a tag in the field.

Step 6:

  • The category shows in the Category field.

Step 7:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 8:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.

Step 9:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 10:

  • Part A's entry shows three tags: tag 1, tag 2 and tag 3 (2 kept + 1 added = 3).
  • No tag was removed.
